The decisive mistake was made by AlgorithmDesign_Expert at Step 4. The Excel file stores the map as cell fill colors, and pandas only reads cell values, so it cannot see them. The code at that step still treated cell values as if they held colors, checking `sheet_data.iloc[x, y] != 'blue'`. A fill-color library such as openpyxl was needed to read each cell's fill and detect blue cells. The BFS also did not model the movement rules properly. It used a visited set and did not follow the START-to-END direction. Everything after this inherited the same flawed approach, so the later steps never recovered the correct hex code.
